name: The Absent Minded Prospector
summary: At the southern ruins of Darkshore, Prospector Remtravel presses on with his dig, hoping to find a prize for the Explorers' League. Hostile troggs and his forgetfulness make the search perilous, and word of his safety must reach his assistant in Auberdine.

sections.title: A Perilous Excavation
sections.body: Far south in Darkshore, Remtravel's Dig lies among ancient ruins. Dwarven excavators searching there uncovered troggs, who drove out the workers and besieged the camp. Remtravel will not leave for Auberdine empty-handed. He wanders into danger to recover a fossil, hoping to justify the expedition's costs to the Explorers' League.

sections.title: Muddled Memories and Trogg Ambushes
sections.body: Keeping Remtravel safe at the excavation is dangerous and frustrating. He circles the site, mistakes brushes for fossils, and blunders past scaffolding and abandoned tents. Each stop draws aggressive troggs from the quarry's shadowed recesses. After travelers clear wave after wave of the subterranean brutes, Remtravel remembers where his prize is: he already gave the fossil to Hollee. He happily returns to work.

faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is a senior field researcher for the dwarven Explorers' League. Stationed in Darkshore, he was sent to excavate ancient coastal ruins, though his extreme absent-mindedness often puts his life in danger.

faq.q: Why is Remtravel still at the dig site?
faq.answer: Remtravel refuses to return to Darnassus without tangible proof of his work. He wants to recover a mysterious fossil to present to the Explorers' League before abandoning the camp.

faq.q: Where did the troggs come from?
aliases: why are there troggs in darkshore
faq.answer: Remtravel's team dug deep into the earth and breached underground pockets inhabited by troggs. The primitive creatures surged up and overran the machinery, tents, and workers.

Archaeologist Hollee is Remtravel's colleague and assistant in Auberdine. Distraught over her mentor's long absence and familiar with his forgetfulness, she asks travelers to find him and ensure he returns safely.

faq.q: What happens after finding the fossil?
faq.answer: After helping Remtravel search the dig, report on his safety to Archaeologist Hollee in Auberdine.

angles.text: For dwarves, Remtravel shows the Explorers' League's fierce passion and stubbornness. His dedication to ancient titan-lore blinds him to the danger around him.
For you as a night elf, dwarven digging in Darkshore may confirm your people's wariness: Remtravel's excavation uncovered a horde of violent troggs beneath sacred ground.
As an Alliance member, helping Remtravel and preserving his findings supports scholarly and diplomatic ties between the dwarven Explorers' League and the night elves of Teldrassil.
